title: Stop Swinging Your Bicep Curls
hook: If you're swinging your curls, you're not really working your biceps.
body: Too much weight plus swinging means your body does the work instead of your bicep. Stand straight up and down, isolate the bicep, and bring the weight right back down.
close: No swinging, no rocking, no momentum.
youtube_description:
